obstacles.note: Leaf overlay on a gem cell. Mechanic: same as chains — cell cannot be swapped until leaf is removed by an adjacent match. 1-HP. Covers both plain-gem cells (G) and acorn cells (A). 33 cells total. Positions 0-indexed.
Acorn collectible embedded under a leaf. Removing the leaf (adjacent match) collects the acorn toward the objective. 19 acorns = full objective. Positions 0-indexed.
